items.title: Anat Cohen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 9, 2021
items.q: Oded is my high school friend and he is the musical director of the tentet, the project that we have together, and he’s also the person that really runs Anzic Records because all the albums that I recorded came out on our own label, a label we established together in 2007

ctx.x: Okay. Do you have someone who has given you career advice over the years?

Wow. There’s little mentors, there’s little phrases here and there, but you know there’s career and then there’s music and there’s a lot of elements to my journey. But a person that has been extremely helpful and by my side as far as suggestions and support and running our record label is Oded Lev-Ari. Oded is my high school friend and he is the musical director of the tentet, the project that we have together, and he’s also the person that really runs Anzic Records because all the albums that I recorded came out…
Okay. I just was curious if he composed this song “Putty Boy Strut”?
